headlines.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Stock Looks Overvalued On Current Assumptions
headlines.summary: Starbucks has delivered a solid year to date gain, yet current valuation checks suggest the stock is trading at a premium to what its cash flows and market multiples imply. Both the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and the broader multiple based view point to Starbucks stock as overvalued on today’s assumptions. The stock is up 26.0% year to date, which leaves recent buyers paying more for each dollar of expected future cash flow than earlier in the year.

headlines.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Brings A New Wellness Bar To Stores Nationwide
headlines.summary: Starbucks (NasdaqGS:SBUX) has begun an in-store retail rollout of Floura Fiber's Blueberry Matcha Daily Fiber Bar across its U.S. locations. The launch brings a wellness focused snack option directly to Starbucks customers alongside existing beverage and food offerings. The partnership introduces Floura Fiber's branded product to Starbucks' nationwide retail footprint, expanding reach for both companies.

headlines.title: Is Starbucks Stock Underperforming the S&P 500?
headlines.summary: Starbucks has underperformed the S&P 500 over the past year, but analysts are cautiously optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
